source_text: Domus in urbe murata intra annum redimatur; postea firma emptori. Tempus gratiae breve. Noli dormire.
pass_a_gloss: House in city walled within year let-it-be-redeemed; afterward firm to-buyer. Time of-grace short. Do-not sleep.
pass_b_english: A [[house in a walled city may be redeemed within a year; afterward it is the buyer’s >> Bible:Leviticus 25:29-30]]. Grace’s time is short. Do not sleep.
